text:
kyle: heads up — after the eu-west OOB fw push at 03:18, ~28 nodes show serial console hang (no login, kernel not progressing). nodes: rack-eu1-[03,07,14,21,22,25,30,31,33,34,...]. Anyone else seeing this?
nina: yep seeing it, noticed secure boot got toggled to "Enabled" on a subset. provisioning failing when PXE chain tries to hand off.
deploy-bot: fw-deploy: batch 9/20 complete, starting batch 10/20 (eu-west). image: bmc-fw-2026-02-rc3
kyle: confirmed deploy-bot timeline matches. Logs show BMC reboots but serial console doesn't come back.
sam: can you paste the bmc serial output? run "oob-console tail" or ipmitool sol info?
kyle: paste logs:
```
[ 0.000000] secure_boot: Disabled -> Enabled (UEFI variable changed)
BMC: rebooting...
console: no response after initramfs
```
laura: if secure boot flipped on, the kernel signature checks could block bootloader (we sign images differently per region). This could cause hang mid-boot.
ben: propose plan: pause remaining batches, start rollback to fw-snapshot-2026-01 for affected nodes, and manual IPMI SOL salvage on ~5 nodes that went into serial lock.
jamie: +1 pause. Also we should avoid mass reboot from provisioning — cordon and drain nodes at k8s layer? Many are dedicated GPUs.
nina: I've already set autoscaler to 0 for the eu-west GPU pool and created a cordon tag: eu-west-oob-rollback. Will start playbook to rollback batch of 10 nodes.
ops-bot: runbook-trigger: oob-fw-rollback initiated by nina for group eu-west-rollback-1.
kyle: manual workaround for a stuck BMC: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H <bmc> -U admin -P **** sol activate` then send ctrl+c, then `ipmitool bmc reset cold` sometimes helps. Use caution.
sam: for nodes where secure boot is enabled we need to zero out the UEFI var or restore previous var store. There's a script: oob/uefi-var-restore.sh — don't run blindly.
laura: question — why did secure boot flip in the first place? vendor fw change maybe toggles default flag. We should escalate to vendor and stop deployment until they confirm.
ben: cost/ops note: pausing deploy will delay rollouts but prevents larger reprovisioning cost. Filing INFRA ticket.
kyle: opened INFRA-8423 with logs + node list. link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFRA-8423
jamie: action items:
- nina: continue rollback playbook and report per-10 nodes
- laura: contact vendor + open vendor ticket, include sample of UEFI var dump
- sam: prepare uefi-var-restore.sh review
- ben: update on-cost impact to infra-corp
nina: rolling now: starting rollback on nodes rack-eu1-[03,07,14,21,22,25,30,31,33,34] batch 1/3. ETA ~12m/batch.
kyle: 👍 will monitor serial and provisioning. tagging @oncall-sre
ops-bot: incident-note: added postmortem template to INFRA-8423
laura: small ask — preserve one affected node for vendor repro (don't roll back that one), set aside rack-eu1-14.
sam: noted, reserving rack-eu1-14 for repro.
ben: updating finance thread about potential compute replacement costs.
kyle: will follow-up when batch 1 completes. Thanks folks :heart:
